sections.Profile:
The "Daffy Derby" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in June 1954, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
